superPowers.name: Army of Evil (Affiliation: Hydra)
superPowers.body: When this Leadership becomes active, add 1 |*Hydra| or |*Unaffiliated| Team Tactic Card from your unused Team Tactic Cards to your available Team Tactic Cards. It may be played this game.|\|Additionally, once each Turn, after 1 or more allied characters pay |!power| to play a Team Tactic Card, choose 1 of the characters that paid |!power| to play the card. The chosen character gains 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Quick Step
superPowers.body: This character Advances |!movement_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Master Duelist
superPowers.body: If this character makes a |*Sword Strike| attack against a character it has already made an attack against this Turn, add 2 dice to the attack roll.

superPowers.name: Strategic Genius
superPowers.body: This character and allied characters within |!range| 2 of it may reroll 1 die in their attack or defense rolls.
